import html # Pre‑defined HTML template with placeholders. INVITATION_FORMAT = """ {event_title} - Invitation

{event_title}

Date: {event_date}
{event_description}
{notes_section} """ def create_event_invitation(e_title: str, e_description: str, e_date: str, e_notes: str) -> str: """ Produce a secure, sanitized HTML invitation for an event. Parameters ---------- e_title : str The title or heading of the event. e_description : str A detailed description of the event. May contain line breaks or formatting. e_date : str The scheduled date of the event. e_notes : str Any additional notes or instructions from the user. Returns ------- str A fully sanitized HTML string ready for safe rendering. """ # Escape all user supplied content to avoid XSS attacks esc_title = html.escape(e_title, quote=True) esc_description = html.escape(e_description, quote=False) # allow line breaks esc_date = html.escape(e_date, quote=True) esc_notes = html.escape(e_notes, quote=False) # Render the notes section only if notes are provided notes_section = f'
Notes:
{esc_notes}
' if esc_notes.strip() else '' # Format the final HTML invitation_html = INVITATION_FORMAT.format( event_title=esc_title, event_date=esc_date, event_description=esc_description, notes_section=notes_section ) return invitation_html
